work.title: Two Discs, Heart
work.description: Two iridescent compact discs are mounted asymmetrically on a white ground layered with torn paper, ink markings, and gestural pencil lines. Black diamond shapes, a hand-drawn heart outline, scattered numerals, and small floral doodles populate the spare, light-filled surface.
work.composition: two discs floating on spare white ground
